column1: # orvel's stack: one row per subcommand, tab separated. Read by install-stack.sh (what to install, checked against its sha256)
# and by orvel (what each subcommand runs). kind: zip, tgz or bin (a release asset, the binary NAME inside it), pip (a
# virtualenv; the version is the package's) or apt (the runner's Ubuntu package; the installed version is what `orvel version` prints).
# The versions and checksums of the tools bench/tools.go and bench/params.go pin are the same here (test_control.py checks).
